answer.rationale: Roll out the confirmed in-product activation messaging: it increased week-one engagement (+11%), activation (+6%), and 30-day retention (+1%), supporting durable qualified revenue. Do not respond to the competitor with broad promotional pricing: the recovered targeted-discount result produced short-term signup and revenue gains but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, and it does not establish that discounts retain already-at-risk customers. Activation messaging may not fully resolve price-driven churn, so monitor the price-sensitive SMB cohort closely while avoiding an unproven, potentially value-destructive discount response.
